results.text: No Increased Risk of Major Adverse Cardiovascular Events following Nicotinamide Exposure. Nicotinamide metabolites have recently been implicated in increased risk of major cardiovascular events (MACE). Supportive data about clinical risk of MACE for nicotinamide users is lacking. To determine whether nicotinamide use results in an increase of MACE.
